title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick's absence due to a cheerleading event during his Hall of Fame speech.
He made a humorous allusion to the Patriots' Deflategate scandal, mentioning a ball boy in his address.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old was struck and killed by a vehicle while riding a bicycle in Williamstown on Friday.
The incident occurred at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road; the child unintentionally entered Main Street.
No arrests or charges have been made; the driver was not impaired by drugs or alcohol, officials confirmed.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise keeping pets out of Ames Pond after a dog died last week.
Algae blooms are suspected but unconfirmed as the cause; E. Coli tests showed no concerns.
Cyanobacterial algae blooms can multiply rapidly, posing risks to humans and animals, especially pets.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, ex-NH state trooper, decertified after admitting to falsely reporting GPS tracking on girlfriend.
Lamoureux received a deferred six-month prison sentence, fully suspended for two years, in a plea agreement.
He resigned from state police and is barred from law enforcement after being added to the decertified officers registry.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a call about a man with a gun at Grace Chapel, later discovering no public threat.
The man was found polishing a powder horn, a historical reenactment accessory, outside due to heat.
Security video confirmed the man's account, leading police to reassure the public of no danger during the incident.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will make playoffs despite holding second A.L. wild-card spot.
Red Sox recently had 15-game winning streak, going 32-5 since June 25, the best in franchise history.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox 96% playoff chance; Parker remains skeptical of their high performance sustainability.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Red Sox's Wilyer Abreu missed Saturday's game due to leg swelling from a hit during Friday's match.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game against the Athletics, pending morning check-in.
Abreu ranks second in home runs (20) and RBIs (62) for the Red Sox, with a .256 average in 2026.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday evening.
Boston lost despite having more hits than the Athletics, leaving 12 runners on base and striking out 15 times.
The loss was Boston's sixth in 38 games, maintaining their hold on the AL's second wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf surface due to an unapproved NFL laboratory testing protocol for its current setup.
The turf previously installed was compliant with FIFA and NFL standards but lacked proper NFL lab testing because of missing 'E-layer'.
The new turf is the same as used in 2025, with plans to complete installation before the Patriots' preseason opener.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, with goals from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Revolution Designated Player Jack Harrison made his debut in the 55th minute, showing potential despite incomplete fitness.
Houston Dynamo successfully countered New England's attack, sealing the win with a Resch goal from a corner in the 63rd minute.
